scope: A separate follow-up to the code44 upgrade record on one already prepared physical phone. This observation belongs only to code44.
preconditions: Original phone accounts and saved AI authorization were retained.
Flyme background and associated startup settings were already enabled, and code42 had needed a manual accessibility-service rebind. These earlier interventions remain part of the device setup.
The phone was already Dozing following code44 automatic upgrade recovery; no manual sleep, wake, permission or UI action was issued to start this window.

observation.method: Read-only adb power, accessibility binding, process and device-idle metadata, approximately every 30 seconds, with a final sample.

conclusions: The full 3600-second window completed with the same process and bound operation service at every sample. Wakefulness stayed Dozing in the samples, and last-wake and last-sleep clocks did not change.
Sampling is not continuous service or task execution monitoring. Dozing here is a screen wakefulness state, not Android deep Doze.
USB supplied power throughout, and read-only adb sampling adds overhead; this is not unplugged endurance.
not_established: Any 60-minute idle result for code45 or a later APK.
A Muse or Instinct task, autonomous wake, SMS GUI read, cross-App result or subsequent-use verification after this window.
Deep Doze, reboot, network-loss recovery, all OEMs or independent new-user installation.
Public APK release or replacement of another phone's primary control path.
privacy: Manually summarized from private metadata. No serial, PID value, account, phone number, message, raw screen, authorization credential or private deployment path is included.
